		trigger = { var:scalar_spell_effect_chance_iteration_4 ?= flag:num_of_known_languages }
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = spell_effect_scaling_artifact_rarity
		trigger = { var:scalar_spell_effect_chance_iteration_4 ?= flag:artifact_rarity }
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = spell_effect_scaling_artifact_aspect_total_value
		trigger = { var:scalar_spell_effect_chance_iteration_4 ?= flag:artifact_aspect_total_value }
	}
	# Activation Conditions
	text = {
		localization_key = spell_effect_scaling_activation_condition
		trigger = { var:scalar_spell_effect_chance_iteration_4 ?= flag:activation_condition }
	}
	# Generic
	text = {
		localization_key = spell_effect_scaling_none
		trigger = { var:scalar_spell_effect_chance_iteration_4 ?= flag:none }
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = spell_effect_scaling_total_level
		fallback = yes
	}
}

			is_target_in_variable_list = {
				name = activation_condition_list
				target = flag:terrain
			}
		}
	}

		trigger = {
			exists = var:spell_activation_condition_trigger_1
		}
	}

		localization_key = spell_effect_activation_condition_none

	}

CantripOvercharge = {
	type = character
	text = {
		localization_key = cantrip_overcharge_epic
		trigger = {
			exists = var:cantrip_skill_overcharge
			var:cantrip_skill_overcharge >= 3
		}
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = cantrip_overcharge_expert
		trigger = {
			exists = var:cantrip_skill_overcharge
			var:cantrip_skill_overcharge = 2
		}
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = cantrip_overcharge_competent
		trigger = {
			exists = var:cantrip_skill_overcharge
			var:cantrip_skill_overcharge = 1
		}
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = cantrip_overcharge_none
		fallback = yes
	}
}
